expression: /*#𝙲𝚞𝚜𝚝𝚘𝚖 𝙵𝚛𝚎𝚗𝚌𝚑 𝚁𝚊𝚗𝚔𝚎𝚍 𝚂𝚝𝚛𝚎𝚊𝚖 𝙴𝚡𝚙𝚛𝚎𝚜𝚜𝚒𝚘𝚗𝚜 to use with 𝚅𝚒𝚍𝚑𝚒𝚗'𝚜 English 𝚁𝚊𝚗𝚔𝚎𝚍 𝚁𝚎𝚐𝚎𝚡𝚎𝚜*/ []

/*FR Original*/ (originalLanguage == 'French') ? merge(language(streams, 'French', 'Original'), regexMatched(streams, 'VOF', 'VOQ'), regexMatched(merge(language(streams, 'Multi'), regexMatched(streams, 'MULTi')), 'FR Groups')) : []
/*FR Dual Dub*/ (originalLanguage != 'French') ? regexMatched(streams, 'VF2') : []

/*FR Dub*/ (originalLanguage != 'French') ? negate(merge(regexMatched(streams, 'VF2'), regexMatched(streams, 'FastSUB')), merge(language(streams, 'French'), regexMatched(streams, 'VOF', 'VFB', 'VOQ', 'VQ', 'VFQ'), regexMatched(merge(language(streams, 'Multi'), regexMatched(streams, 'MULTi')), 'FR Groups'))) : []
/*#beluchon + yoyovero + TRaSH*/ /*FR Group*/ negate(regexMatched(streams, 'FastSUB'), regexMatched(streams, 'FR Groups'))

/*FR HD Bluray T1*/ negate(regexMatched(streams, 'VOSTFR'), regexMatched(negate(resolution(streams, '2160p'), streams), 'FR HD Bluray T1'))
/*FR UHD Bluray T2*/ negate(regexMatched(streams, 'VOSTFR'), regexMatched(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'FR UHD Bluray T2'))
/*FR HD Bluray T2*/ negate(regexMatched(streams, 'VOSTFR'), regexMatched(negate(resolution(streams, '2160p'), streams), 'FR HD Bluray T2'))
/*FR WEB T1*/ negate(regexMatched(streams, 'VOSTFR'), regexMatched(streams, 'FR WEB T1'))
/*FR WEB T2*/ negate(regexMatched(streams, 'VOSTFR'), regexMatched(streams, 'FR WEB T2'))

/*VFB*/ regexMatched(streams, 'VFB')
/*VQ*/ regexMatched(streams, 'VQ')

/*FR FanSUB*/ isAnime ? [] : negate(regexMatched(streams, 'VOSTFR'), regexMatched(streams, 'FanSUB'))

/*FR LQ Watermark*/ regexMatched(streams, 'FR LQ Watermarks')

/*FR LQ False Release*/ regexMatched(streams, 'FR LQ False Releases')

/*Non-FR*/ originalLanguage != 'French' and isAnime ? negate(merge(regexMatched(streams, 'FR LQ Watermarks', 'FR LQ ReTAG', 'FR LQ False Releases', 'FR LQ Other Reasons', 'FastSUB', 'VOSTFR', 'FR Groups', 'VF2', 'VFF', 'VFI', 'VOF', 'VFB', 'VOQ', 'VQ', 'VFQ'), language(streams, 'French'), subtitle(streams, 'French')), streams) : originalLanguage != 'French' ? negate(merge(regexMatched(streams, 'FR LQ Watermarks', 'FR LQ ReTAG', 'FR LQ False Releases', 'FR LQ Other Reasons', 'FastSUB', 'FanSUB', 'VOSTFR', 'FR Groups', 'VF2', 'VFF', 'VFI', 'VOF', 'VFB', 'VOQ', 'VQ', 'VFQ'), language(streams, 'French'), subtitle(streams, 'French')), streams) : []
